service.description: Open a document into a room: a saved one (definitionId), a new one over a data grid source (source, with columns, sort and filter, as get#DataGridRows takes them), or a workbook file (workbookLocation: an xlsx with its formulas and styles, or xls, xlsb, ods and other xlsx as values). Each data sheet is read as the caller, up to maxDataRows rows, and the workbook is evaluated.

parameter.name: profileId
parameter.description: The access profile to read under; without it the Tools app's own access.

parameter.name: sheets
parameter.description: Each sheet: index, name, rows and columns (its used area), widths (pixels, by column), frozenRows, frozenColumns, data (a read-only data sheet), dataRows, hidden.

parameter.name: charts
parameter.description: Each chart of the document (title, type, categories, series) with labels and each series' data read from the ranges it names, or its error.

parameter.name: truncated
parameter.description: The data sheets whose source had more than maxDataRows rows.

service.description: A rectangle of a sheet's cells, at most 20,000, as JSON text: row, column, width, height, styles (the distinct styles, conditional formats and neighbours' borders applied), style_indices (one for each cell, by row), texts (row, column, text as formatted, cell_type) of the cells that have one, and fills as runs.
Read the room's data sheets again as the caller and evaluate; the overlay stays as it is.

Save the room's document as a report definition of type calcgrid: its data sheets' sources, its charts and its workbook without the data (no row of a data sheet, no value computed from one, none of the data's texts). A room opened from a saved document saves that one, at the version it was read; any other saves a new one under definitionId, or an id made from the title.

parameter.name: profileId
parameter.description: Under a profile only an author saves (update on org.moqui.calc.document).

parameter.name: userGroupId
parameter.description: Share the document with this group, as save#Definition allows.

service.description: The workbook as it is in the room, with its data and calculated values, as an xlsx.
Drop the caller's room; a room not used for twenty minutes is dropped without it.

How the caller may use CalcGrid: tools (the Tools app's own access: every source of the data grid, no filter), the access profiles they hold (profileId, description), and canAuthor (they make and save documents). A profile is an artifact group with the artifact org.moqui.calc.profile.[profileId] (inheritAuthz Y) and an artifact org.moqui.calc.entity.[entityName] (or a pattern) for each entity and view it offers, granted AUTHZT_ALWAYS for view, with the entity filter sets of the grant as its row scope.
The entities and views a new document may be over whose name holds term, fifty at most: the ones the profile offers (a view only with every member entity offered), or with no profile every entity.

Apply edits to the room's workbook in order and evaluate once. Each of ops is a map with op: input (sheet, row, column, value: a cell set as a person typing would, so =A1*2 is a formula; empty clears it), paste (sheet, row, column, rows: rows of texts from a top-left cell), clear and style (sheet, row, column, width, height; style with path and value: font.b, font.i, font.u, font.strike, font.color, fill.color, num_fmt, alignment.horizontal, alignment.wrap_text), fill (a source rectangle and toRow or toColumn: autofill), width (sheet, column, columnEnd, width) and height (sheet, row, rowEnd, height) in pixels, freeze (sheet, rows, columns), insertRows and deleteRows (sheet, row, count), insertColumns and deleteColumns (sheet, column, count), addSheet, renameSheet (sheet, name), deleteSheet (sheet), charts (the document's charts, replaced: each a title, a type of bar, column, line, area or pie, categories and series of name and values, ranges), undo and redo. A data sheet's cells, rows, columns and name are not edited; its widths, heights and frozen panes are. The first edit refused is the call's error, the edits before it stay, and the room's state is answered either way. Under a profile only an author edits. Nothing is saved: save#CalcDocument saves.
What was typed into a cell (a formula with its =, a number or a text as entered), for the formula bar and a cell's editor.

A range of a saved document as a table for the report engine: the source of the shipped dataset calcgrid (its serviceName), so a dashboard panel, a report and a scheduled report show a CalcGrid range with the query parameters definitionId and range. The first row of the range names the columns; each row below is a record, at most 10,000. The document's data is read as the caller under profileId, or with none under their current access: the one they chose in CalcGrid (set#CalcProfile) while they hold it, else the Tools app's own when they have it, else the first profile they hold. A room the caller has for the document is read again, its data read anew when over a minute old.

parameter.name: frame
parameter.description: fields, each a name, a type (number or string) and its values.

service.description: Keep the access the caller chose as their current one (the user preference calc.profile): a profile they hold, or tools for the Tools app's own access. A dashboard panel and a scheduled report over a CalcGrid document read under it when they name no profile.
